item.title: Speeches
item.author: massimo.nocentini@gmail.com (Massimo Nocentini)
item.description: Three speeches: Coach D’Amato’s locker-room address in “Any Given Sunday”, where life and football are both a game of inches; Steve Jobs at Stanford, telling three stories about connecting the dots, love and loss, and death; and Martin Luther King’s “I Have a Dream” at the Lincoln Memorial, cashing the promissory note of the Republic and letting freedom ring.
